title: Ledger is encrypted
hint: Enter the master passphrase to unlock your data
relocated: Data location migration finished; the app will restart shortly
resetTitle: Reset to a fresh empty ledger?
resetBody:
There is no backdoor and no way to recover the master passphrase: once it is forgotten, the data in this ledger cannot be recovered by the app.

Continuing resets the ledger to a fresh empty plaintext file and the app starts over immediately; encryption can be enabled again afterwards.

The current ledger is kept as an encrypted copy (unreadable without the passphrase) — the data can still be recovered later if you remember it.
resetOk: Reset to a fresh empty ledger
rememberHint: When on, the master passphrase is stored securely in this device's keychain (reads require Touch ID on macOS) so the next launch unlocks automatically without re-entering it; turning it off returns to manual entry. It applies to this device only — you'll still enter it manually on another device or after restoring a backup elsewhere.
rememberFailed: Couldn't enable auto-unlock; keeping manual entry
